response.sql:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
), status_avgs AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, o.overall_avg
  FROM status_avgs AS sa
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE sa.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg
), qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_qualifying_avg
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT q.rfistat AS status,
       q.avg_modindex,
       q.avg_modindex - q.overall_avg AS above_average_by,
       q.avg_modindex - qm.mean_qualifying_avg AS difference_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS qm;

assumptions.assumption: “Above-average” compares each status group’s average modulation index with the overall average across signals that have a non-NULL modulation index. The final difference is status average minus the mean of the qualifying status averages; NULL statuses form their own group.
